posts.subject: Apology
posts.bodyHtml:
I just wanted to apologize from bottom of my heart to everyone I did wrong to, I have had a talk with @Hypnoxas about this not long ago and this made me think what a immature <Excuse my words> but what a immature little cunt or prick I was towards everyone this talk not made me think just about community but about myself to and made me ask questions to myself "Do I really wanna be like this? a player that is seemed rather unwelcomed by players and community" and I instantly thought "no" Hypnoxas is a great person even tho I spammed him on steam and crossed the line with his patience he still managed to talk to me on teamspeak which has totally shocked me as I thought he will don't want to know me any longer, it will take time for me to change it's not something that happens in few hours/days/weeks no it takes months and thankfully towards Hypnoxas I have realized this and thought about it.


I would like to make special apology to @Nachtfrische and @Sky for pressing on you guys well too much I did not realize it before but I did now and what I did is completely wrong I don't want you guys to think that I'm a <Excuse my words again> that I'm a immature little fucker, not that's not what I want you guys to think I want everyone to have a good opinion on my not just think that I'm a troll that don't respect anyone that's not true, I have forced a lot on Nachtfrische and sky by asking stupid questions which I already knew the asnwers to but I still did it, I don't know why maybe I was attention seeking but really I don't want you Nachtfrische nor Sky or any member of the community to havre a bad opinion on me, I want to be welcomed as everyone else.


This is all I got to say again I'm really sorry to everyone and hope you will accept me in community again as a member.


Sorry from bottom of my heart,


OxygeN

Hmmmm, very nice of you to make this sweet apology post to all those mentioned people and to the general Dream community. However, I'm sure we've all forgiven you for what you've done in your past (if not, you wouldn't be here I guess) but words really don't mean anything unless you show it. Again, very nice of you to post this apology but I'm sure me, along with the rest of the community would be even more delighted if you was to SHOW that you have changed into a better person.


By this I mean, you can try to act appropriately on the servers, keeping things in order when an admin isn't there (which I know is what you sometimes try to do), make the server fun (as fun as I make it if you can [;)] ) and generally, show the people on the server that you've changed. It's a bit of a chain reaction - if the players think you've changed - they'll show it to the players on the other servers - then they'll show it to the admins and then eventually, everyone will recognise that you've changed.


And hey, if you can do this before your application gets answered, then it will definitely give you a better chance of passing and fulfilling your goal of becoming a Dream admin again.


Good luck,


~Doo Doo
